## What changed

Describe the observable styling or maintenance change.

## Risk and compatibility

- [ ] Existing selectors and public asset names remain compatible.
- [ ] Date states, color schemes, right-to-left, inline, and multiple-month layouts were considered.
- [ ] Generated-asset, dependency, automation, and packaging implications are identified.

## Validation

- [ ] Regression coverage was added or the reason it is unnecessary is stated.
- [ ] `npm ci --ignore-scripts`, `npm audit`, and `npm run check` pass.
- [ ] Generated CSS and source maps are committed and synchronized.
